attackers_goals: An attacker may attempt to gain higher privileges.
description: A suspicious process was spawned with a High or System integrity level, which is higher than its parent process. This may indicate malicious privilege escalation.
investigative_actions: Check whether the command line executed is benign or normal for the host and/or user performing it. Investigate the endpoint to determine if it's a legitimate process that is supposed to run with privileges.
name: Suspicious process executed with a high integrity level
